dependency_rules.text: Maturity and refinancing risk: the term loan has bullet principal and the revolving facility requires a fresh approval for renewal. Mitigant review: obtain a supported maturity repayment plan. Facility maturity terms alone do not evidence available refinancing.

Security enforceability risk: the proposed mortgage and rent assignment are described in the term sheet, but legal perfection requires separate evidence and no corporate guarantee is assumed. Potential mitigant: the proposed security remains subject to legal review and perfection; it is not treated as an established recovery source.

Interest-rate risk: the proposed facilities are priced over SORA. Mitigant review: assess debt-service sensitivity and any facility-specific hedging evidence. The quoted pricing does not establish hedging protection.

Repayment assumption risk: the property forecast assumes unchanged rents on uncommitted renewals and has no committed refinancing receipt. Mitigant review: obtain support for rental continuity and additional repayment funding; address the property cash-flow shortfall.

Valuation risk: the fully drawn term loan is sensitive to the latest property appraisal. Reassess the mortgage LTV and covenant headroom on each revised valuation before drawdown; a lower value reduces the collateral buffer. Obtain evidence of title, ranking and enforceability before relying on security recovery.
